name: multidimensional-grouping
description: Measure two-dimensional grouping over low-cardinality dimensions

queries.name: region-category
queries.sql: SELECT region, category, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY region, category ORDER BY region, category LIMIT 100

queries.name: region-status
queries.sql: SELECT region, status, COUNT(*) FROM events GROUP BY region, status ORDER BY region, status LIMIT 100
